questions.question: God gave the revelation of Jesus Christ to show His servants what must soon happen. Who did God send to make it known to John?
In John's vision, he turned and saw seven golden lampstands. How did John describe the One among them?

answers.text: One like the Son of Man

questions.question: When John saw the One like the Son of Man in his vision on Patmos, what did John do?

answers.text: Fell at His feet like a dead man
Covered his face and turned away
Grabbed a scroll and started writing

questions.question: In John's vision, the One like the Son of Man said He holds the keys of Hades and of what else?
